ov: About 40 species of dark, fish-eating water birds, including the shags. They dive from the surface and swim with their feet, and short wings give them among the highest flying costs of any bird. Many have bare blue, orange, red or yellow facial skin, brightest when breeding.

why.p: Not kept as a pet, but people in China and Japan have long trained cormorants to catch fish for them.

rg: Coasts and inland waters worldwide, except the central Pacific islands.
df: Fish, caught by diving from the surface.
fx: Cormorants nest in colonies on coasts, in trees, and on islets and cliffs.
Imperial shags have been filmed diving as deep as 80 m to feed on the sea floor.
